claims.text: The datasets used include the LibriSpeech corpus (English) and the GlobalPhone corpus (French, German, Czech, Spanish).
The LibriSpeech corpus consists of 960 hours of English audio data, while the GlobalPhone corpus includes segments from four low-resource languages.
